system.description:
Usage worn mask; Weight 1 lb.

The mask is deliberately expressionless. Its mouth is closed, because according to its makers the important part of speaking with spirits is learning when not to speak.

You gain a +2-status bonus to Diplomacy, Nature or Occultism checks made specifically to communicate or negotiate with spirits. Only one of these skills applies to any individual check.

On the sheet: +2 status is offered on Diplomacy, Nature and Occultism to communicate with spirits.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 11.

conditionals.label: Spirit-Speaker's Mask
conditionals.scope: Diplomacy, Nature or Occultism checks to communicate or negotiate with spirits (one skill per check)
